title: CS2 World Bundle instance record
description: One line of instances.jsonl. The file is JSON Lines: one complete JSON object per line, no enclosing array, so a huge city streams. This schema validates a single line.

id.description: Producer-local stable identifier of this instance (the ECS entity index). Unique within the bundle. Present so sub-objects can reference their owner.

parent.description: The 'id' of the owning instance when this record came from an owner's SubObject buffer (a street tree on a road, a prop on a lot, a wing of a building). Absent for free-standing instances. 'pos'/'rot' are already baked to world space either way.

kind.description: Coarse class, for consumers that treat foliage or decals differently. Closed set in schema 1.

pos.description: World position in bundle-frame metres (left-handed, X=east, Y=up, Z=north).

rot.description: World rotation as a unit quaternion [x, y, z, w] in the bundle frame.

attrs.description: Semantic attributes. Free-form: a consumer must ignore keys it does not know, and must not require any key to be present. The documented keys below are the ones the producer emits when available.

elevation.description: How far the object stands above the terrain (or water) surface, in metres. Signed - negative means buried. Absent for objects sitting flat on the ground. This is NOT the ground's own height: ground level is pos[1] - elevation.

elevationFlags.description: CS2 ElevationFlags names: 'Stacked', 'OnGround', 'Lowered', 'OnAttachedParent'. 'Lowered' marks a deliberate below-ground placement. Open - ignore what you do not recognise.

decalLayers.description: For kind 'decal': which surfaces the game projects this decal onto. CS2 DecalLayers names: 'Terrain', 'Roads', 'Buildings', 'Vehicles', 'Creatures', 'Other'. See contract section 4.2a. Open - ignore what you do not recognise.

decalHeight.description: For kind 'decal': the height in metres of the volume the marking was projected through - what a consumer needs to re-project the producer's flat quad onto a cambered or sloped surface. Not a thickness. See contract section 4.2a.

height.description: True height in metres, measured from the mesh bounds. Metadata attributes never override this.

growthScale.description: The uniform scale the game draws a growing tree at (a sqrt-lerp between the prefab's per-stage sizes). Multiply into the instance transform. Absent means 1.

colorSet.description: The paint this instance was drawn with: three linear RGBA channels (CS2 ColorSet), selected per texel by the material's colorMask map (section 7.1/7.2). This is the game's resolved answer, not an index into colors.json.

colorCustom.description: True when colorSet is a player-painted override rather than the game's random variation.

assetId.description: Filesystem-safe: ASCII alphanumerics, dot, underscore and hyphen; must start with an alphanumeric.
